next_action.description: Make Fabio's three changes to the Enhance button - read plan.md `## Current State` top block first, it carries the detail and three traps that are already checked. (1) The button becomes an `MpiButton`, PINK (`variant: 'primary'` = `--accent-heat`, what Generate uses) with the `enhance` icon that already exists at js/utils/icons.js:37, and it must change BACKGROUND on hover the way the rest of the app does. `--accent-frost` was wrong: Fabio's words are that it is used in ~3% of the app and should not be used anywhere. (2) On the RUN SLIDE the Enhance button must sit directly UNDER the prompt box, not down beside Generate - that is the `--stacked` flex-growth, and fixing it also moves Extend Video's and Add Foley's run slides, so check both after. (3) Size and placement otherwise stay. The three traps: MpiButton in ICON MODE forces `secondary` (MpiButton.js:70 maps everything except danger/ghost down), so passing `primary` with an icon comes out grey; the `button` branch lives in the SHARED js/utils/declaredFields.js (MPI-580's plugin dropdown uses it too) and a mounted Primitive there needs the `radio` branch's destroy; and `_paintEnhance()` currently repaints by qs-ing the raw button, which becomes the instance API. To SEE any of it, paste the scratch FlowDef from validation.md back into flowsRegistry.js and delete it again before committing.

key_decisions: NO NEW COMPONENT, and that was the right call for a reason that is not laziness: a Flow carries no JS (MPI-572), so a `prompt` step KIND would have needed the `{media, value, onChange}` contract on a flow with no media at all, and its value would have landed in `stepValues[role]` - a DIFFERENT store from the run slide's, which is exactly the divergence rule 4 forbids. A `fields` step has no role, so flow-level is the only coherent store and rule 4 falls out for free.

ONE declaration drives three behaviours. Fill, clear-on-edit and the button's state all read the same from/to pair, and the Run fallback derives from it too. A separate `fallbackFrom:` was drafted and dropped - a pair wired one way is a bug that only shows on the run nobody edited.

`--accent-frost` IS A COLOUR TO MOVE AWAY FROM (Fabio, 2026-08-20): 'only used in 3% of the app... it actually should be a colour that shouldn't be used anywhere. We end up using it for some reason.' 63 occurrences across styles/ and js/. Do not reach for it as a signal colour again.
The user-visible signal that a prompt is NOT enhanced must survive whatever replaces `--stale`. On the run slide the enhanced prompt is invisible, so the button is the only thing that can say it.

Storing a seed stays rejected. The enhanced text is stored and injected verbatim, so a seed adds nothing - but the enhancer seed IS load-bearing inside the run, and the frame drives a fresh one per press.

A SCREENSHOT IS PART OF VERIFYING THIS UI, not a nicety. Every DOM assertion passed while the step was visibly broken - the prompt sat 260px above the button and the boxes were narrower than it. Measure AND look.

THE GPU NEEDS THE LEASE for anything that executes a generation: python "${CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT}/skills/mpi-lib/scripts/gpu_lease.py" run -- <command>. Machine-global, one slot. Read-only probes are not matched.

NEVER take the user's app on :3000. Spin your own with `npm run app:isolated` - it prints `READY <url>`. DO NOT pipe that command through `head`/`tail`: the buffer swallows the READY line and a working launch reads as a hang, then the orphaned Electron holds the profile and the NEXT launch dies at exit 0 with an EPERM on cubric-agent-profile. Stopping it needs the process TREE (`taskkill /PID <parent> /T /F`); TaskStop leaves the Electron running.
comfy_workflows/raw/ is USER-OWNED. The enhancer graph's `Input_Seed` node is Fabio's edit to make, not an app-side workaround.
